mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_like ( post_id, user_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS title, p.likes_count AS likeCount, p.save_count AS bookmarkCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment pc WHERE pc.post_id = p.post_id ) AS commentCount, l.created_at AS likedAt FROM post_like l JOIN post p ON p.post_id = l.post_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.post_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like l JOIN post p ON p.post_id = l.post_id JOIN course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
